title: Karuppu Durai
desc: Karuppu Durai, an elderly man, runs away from home after learning his family's plan to kill him using euthanasia. His life takes a turn when he meets a young, orphaned boy.

title: Naa Saami Ranga
desc: A man gains great notoriety in his village for his unmatched strength and brutal nature, which makes him a target of antisocial elements with a ruthless agenda.

title: Kondraal Paavam
desc: The life of a poverty-stricken family becomes more complicated after an unanticipated visitor who goes by the name Arjunan, enters their household.

title: Ragalai
desc: Karthik's mother decides to marry him to her brother's daughter Indu. However, when the uncle insults Karthik's family, he goes on a mission to destroy him.

title: Silukkuvarpatti Singam
desc: Police constable Shakthi prefers a laid back approach to his job and tries to actively stay away from danger. But he is forced to change this attitude when he inadvertently jails a wanted don.

title: Ivan Veramathiri
desc: Guna kidnaps Eeswaran, brother of a minister, for orchestrating violence among students. However, Eeswaran escapes and trails after Guna to exact his revenge.

title: Ganesh
desc: Ganesh, a young man, is forced to pretend to be in love with Divya. However, trouble ensues when he truly starts liking her and must convince her of his feelings.

title: Ranam
desc: After leaving his life of crime behind, Aadhi is drawn back into the drug trade by his former gang leader. However, after meeting Seema and falling in love, he decides to atone for his past mistakes.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Amara Kaviyam
desc: Karthika and Jeeva, two college-going students, fall in love with each other but are forced to separate by their families. However, when they try to reunite, tragedy strikes.

title: Sangathalaivan
desc: A humble textile worker meets a staunch Communist after a tragic incident. Subsequently, he joins the movement after enduring exploitation, sparking a fight for workers' rights.

title: Kuselan
desc: Two childhood friends lose touch over the years as one grows up to become a national figure while another makes a living out of barbering. Little do they know that a surprise reunion is on the cards.

title: Yashoda
desc: Surrogate mother Yashodha is advised to follow a few guidelines to keep herself and her baby healthy and safe. However, something happens at the surrogate centre that puts both of them at risk.

title: Raame Aandalum Raavane Aandalum
desc: An impoverished rural couple look for their prized bulls, which have gone missing. However, they receive little help from a community that is apathetic to their plight.

title: Arjun S/O Vyjayanthi
desc: Arjun, a gangster, learns that a terrorist wants to take revenge from his mother, who is an IPS officer. In order to protect her, he strives to overcome all the odds.

title: Hitler
desc: Selva's move to Chennai for work leads to unexpected involvement in crime. As the city falls into disarray, a dishonest politician manoeuvres for control.
